antigravity.name: Google Antigravity (the agy CLI), on the signed-in Google account's plan
limits: the plan's own usage allowance, shared by every Antigravity run on that account; the plan decides its size and its reset
antigravity.check: the usage agy reports after each run (the `usage` field of agy_run.py's JSON)

chatgpt-images.name: ChatGPT image generation on chatgpt.com, on the signed-in account's plan
limits: the plan's image allowance per time window; ChatGPT says when it is reached and when it resets
chatgpt-images.check: the message ChatGPT shows when the limit is reached, with its reset time

grok-imagine.name: Grok Imagine image and video generation on grok.com, on the signed-in account's plan
limits: the plan's generation allowance per time window; Grok says when it is reached and when it resets
grok-imagine.check: the notice grok.com shows when the limit is reached, with its reset time

twitterapi-io.name: twitterapi.io, the paid X/Twitter read API
limits: prepaid credits, spent per call by the number of items returned; the price list is on twitterapi.io
twitterapi-io.check: the twitterapi.io dashboard, which shows the balance
